# Bailey Code

> Bailey Code is the practice of Tony Bailey in Melbourne, Australia. Two separate services: AI consulting for human services organisations, and counselling and coaching (opening after Tony completes his Masters of Counselling). Both rest on one idea: everyone and every organisation runs on a code, and understanding it is how change begins. Tagline: figuring out the code to finding you.

## Services
- [AI consulting for human services](https://baileycode.com/ai-consulting): AI audits, written governance, workflow builds and training for disability providers, allied health, aged care and community organisations in Australia.
- [Counselling and coaching](https://baileycode.com/counselling): Trauma-informed counselling for addiction, recovery, late ADHD diagnosis and trauma. Not yet taking clients; waitlist open.

## Guides
- [ADHD and addiction: the link, explained](https://baileycode.com/adhd-and-addiction)
- [NDIS terms in plain English](https://baileycode.com/ndis-plain-english)
